description: Send your reply to the council's latest message, after council_join, council_turn or council_result returned your turn, and wait for the next step. Only for councils started with council_join; the text is passed to the other model as written, so write the complete reply yourself. If the council is not waiting for you, it says so and you call council_result instead; if the next step takes longer than about 50 s, call council_result with the council_id.

council_id.description: The council_id from the message you are replying to.

text.description: Your complete reply to that message, written by you.

name: council_turn

council_id.description: With your_turn: the council to reply to with council_turn.

job_id.description: With working or stopped: the job to wait for, or the one stopped.

status.description: done: text is the answer. working: still running; call council_result with job_id. your_turn (council_join): text is the council's message; reply with council_turn and council_id. stopped: council_cancel stopped job_id.

text.description: The answer (council_debate: its JSON), or the message to act on; the same as the text content.

title: Send your turn to the council
